name: India–Pakistan
value: Indus treaty suspended; no new LoC strike
summary: India keeps the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance; a Pakistani minister attends an SCO dialogue in New Delhi
state: India continues to hold the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. Pakistan nominated Climate Minister Musadik Malik for an SCO dialogue in New Delhi, the first visit by a Pakistani minister to India in three years (Dawn). No cross-border strike, mobilisation or major attack with blame assigned was found as of 16 Nov; the continuing treaty suspension keeps Watch.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for areas near the India–Pakistan border and the Line of Control.
